scope: OpenFreeMap component registry only. This is an interim sort and does not replace the original master GeoJSON (22,977 features) and master CSV (24,102 rows), which still need direct ID/source reconciliation.
geographic_sector_method: Grid by floor(longitude*1000), floor(latitude*1000); approximately 100 m east-west and 110 m north-south in Ermita. This is an organizational grid, not an official boundary.

interpretation.accepted_high_confidence: Existing OFM registry has an accepted OSM ID and confidence >= 0.90; still not proof of official identity.
interpretation.candidate_requires_review: Potential OSM candidate only; do not copy its tags yet.
interpretation.linked_needs_review: OSM ID exists but confidence is below 0.90.
interpretation.verified_complete_candidate: Requires identity, vertical size, address, facade, roof and confirmed building-specific photo evidence. Current count is zero.

geometry_policy: Source component indices, coordinates, render heights and source geometry are preserved; only derived sorting/classification columns are added.
